name: 0.1-31-456aa21
notes: Stage separates pitched up with a burst of venting gas and icy flecks. Autopilot pauses 1.5 s before each tap. Soundtrack no longer restarts mid-flight.

name: 0.1-29-c3ca0f5
notes: Smooth stage separation: the camera, outline, puff and flames now ease instead of popping. Includes the two-stage flight from build 28.

name: 0.1-28-f13f78c
notes: Two-stage flight: separate, then open the cap and release the satellite from the upper stage. Guide line and camera ease in and out. Soundtrack fades at the end. Engine line follows the rocket. Old flow in Tuning.

name: 0.1-24-4aa1ac8
notes: Flip is clear now: a ghost rocket shows the target pose (nose chevrons, engine at the base), WRONG WAY warning when turned around, and a clear failure message.

name: 0.1-23-72aea64
notes: Full flight: climb, flat orbit, dramatic payload release, fall and flip, grid-fin re-entry, landing on a pad ahead. AUTO flies it all.
